name: ST NUCLEO-H755ZI-Q
record_note: The MB1363 H755 board uses 8 MHz ST-LINK MCO as default HSE; UM2408 also documents a 25 MHz X2 HSE crystal path and a default 32.768 kHz X3 LSE crystal. HSE can be changed by solder-bridge configuration and ST-LINK firmware. Board revision, dual-core startup, pin reservations, build, and flash profiles remain open.
